verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server (trivy-mcp) that integrates with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, letting coding agents invoke Trivy's scanning and query results in natural language — a direct fit for wiring into an AI coding agent. However, evidence is limited to first-party docs with no independent hands-on account of this specific workflow catching AI-generated code issues pre-merge. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP integration in real agent workflows, and specifics on scanning AI-generated code specifically before it lands (e.g., pre-commit/pre-merge gating via the agent).
